title: Cut-Off Dates and Attendee Reservation Methods for Group Room Blocks
content:
Every Group Room Blocks type has a cut-off date a fixed number of calendar days before arrival, and one method by which attendees reserve inside the block. Where the method is a rooming list, the list has its own due date and a last day for name changes, both counted in calendar days before arrival.

| Block type | Cut-off (calendar days before arrival) | All unreserved room nights released at cut-off | Attendees booking after cut-off still receive the group rate while rooms are available | Reservation method | Rooming list due (calendar days before arrival) | Rooming-list names may be changed until (calendar days before arrival) | Attendee reservations guaranteed by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 30 | Yes | No | Individual call-in | 0 | 0 | the attendee's own credit card |
| Wedding Room Block | 30 | Yes | Yes | Individual call-in | 0 | 0 | the attendee's own credit card |
| Sports Team Room Block | 14 | Yes | No | Rooming list | 14 | 2 | the group master account |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 21 | Yes | No | Rooming list | 30 | 7 | the group master account |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 21 | Yes | No | Individual call-in | 0 | 0 | the attendee's own credit card |
| Association Convention Room Block | 30 | Yes | No | Individual call-in | 0 | 0 | the attendee's own credit card |

### Notes to the schedule

- The rooming-list columns show 0 days for block types whose attendees call in individually, because those types do not use a rooming list.
- The two rooming-list types are also the two types whose attendee reservations are guaranteed to the group master account.

### Calendar illustration (hypothetical arrival)

For a Tour & Travel Series Block arriving on a given day, the rooming list is due 30 calendar days before that day, the cut-off date falls 21 calendar days before it, and names on the list may be changed until 7 calendar days before it. For a Sports Team Room Block arriving the same day, the rooming list is due and the cut-off date falls on the same day, 14 calendar days before arrival, and names may be changed until 2 calendar days before arrival.
